why: Severs the shellTrail dev flag from the renderer, so `?dev=1&shellTrail=segments` parses, validates and shows as set in the Developer panel while no trail is ever built. For an experiment that exists to be turned on and compared (issue #688), that reads as the treatment not helping rather than never running. Invisible to the render and presentation tests, which never go through loop.ts, and to the exact-object option tests, which only pin the default null.
killedBy: startGameWith: dev flags stay off by default threads the shellTrail dev flag through to the renderer (issue #688)
